title: Human GAPDH RT-qPCR
author: Christian Viertler
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qrgdv3w

steps.title: Fix and store tissue samples
steps.instruction: Divide each case into equal aliquots for (i) snap‑freezing, (ii) neutral‑buffered formalin (NBF) fixation, and (iii) PAXgene Tissue fixation; snap‑freeze in methyl‑butane cooled by liquid nitrogen and store at ‑80 °C; fix in NBF at room temperature for 3 h, 24 h or up to 120 h; fix in PAXgene Tissue Fixative at room temperature for 3 h, 24 h or up to 120 h, then transfer to PAXgene Tissue Stabilizer for 24 h to up to 120 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Process and embed fixed tissues
steps.instruction: Run NBF‑fixed and PAXgene‑fixed samples on a Tissue‑Tek VIP Vacuum Infiltration Processor using stepwise dehydration in 70 %, 80 %, 90 % and 99 % ethanol, followed by isopropanol and xylene, limiting each step to ≤1 h; infiltrate and embed with low‑melting‑point paraffin; store resulting PFPE and FFPE blocks in the dark at room temperature and at 4 °C; keep cryo‑preserved tissue in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Extract RNA from each tissue type
steps.instruction: For cryo tissue, weigh 20–70 mg frozen material, extract with Invitrogen TRIzol (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and dissolve the RNA in 20–200 µl RNase‑free water; store at ‑70 °C. For FFPE, cut 10–20 sections of 5 µm thickness, extract with the QIAGEN RNeasy FFPE kit, elute in 40 µl RNase‑free water and store at ‑70 °C. For PFPE, cut 10–20 sections of 5 µm thickness, extract with the PreAnalytiX PAXgene Tissue RNA kit, elute in 40 µl Buffer TR4 and store at ‑70 °C.

steps.title: Quantify and assess RNA quality
steps.instruction: Measure RNA yield and purity on a Nanodrop ND‑1000 spectrophotometer at 260 nm; evaluate integrity using an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer with the Agilent 2100 Expert software.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA by reverse transcription
steps.instruction: Combine 1 µg total RNA with 20 µl High‑Capacity cDNA Reverse Transcription Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific) following the manufacturer’s instructions; store the resulting cDNA at ‑20 °C until use.

steps.title: Prepare RT‑qPCR reaction mix
steps.instruction: Dilute cDNA 1:32 (final concentration 1.56 ng/µl) and use 4 µl as template; add 5 µl 2× Power SYBR Green PCR Master Mix (Thermo Fisher Scientific), 0.05 µl forward primer (100 pmol/µl), 0.05 µl reverse primer (100 pmol/µl), and water to a final volume of 10 µl per reaction.

steps.title: Run RT‑qPCR with cycling program
steps.instruction: Dispense reactions into a MicroAmp Optical 384‑Well Reaction Plate; run on an ABI 7900 Real‑Time PCR System (Thermo Fisher Scientific) using ABI SDS v2.4 software with the following program: Stage 1 (Hold) 2 min at 50 °C, then 10 min at 95 °C; Stage 2 (PCR) 15 s at 95 °C, 45 cycles of 1 min at 60 °C; Stage 3 (Melt Curve) 15 s at 95 °C, 1 min at 60 °C, 15 s at 95 °C. Perform all samples and controls in triplicate and use the mean Ct for analysis.

steps.title: Validate qPCR results
steps.instruction: Confirm amplicon size by agarose‑gel electrophoresis and assess specificity with melt‑curve analysis; ensure no‑template controls show no Ct; accept only reactions with Ct < 40 and melt curves free of extraneous peaks; discard any data not meeting these criteria.
